summary: A BBN notice that use of IMP DDT, the debugging facility on the network's IMP machines, would be restricted, after workshop attendees worried that uncontrolled use endangered access control. The Network Control Center still needed to be able to use it at any IMP, so some commands were protected. It was written for security reasons.

eli5.summary: Because anyone could use a powerful repair tool on the network boxes and cause trouble, access to it was limited to the people who needed it.
